title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 92
paragraphs: Darius then set out from there and came to another river, whose name is Artescos, which flows through the land of the Odrysians. Having come to this river, he acted as follows. He marked out a place for his army and bade every man, as he passed out by it, place one stone in this appointed place. When the army had done so, he marched his army away, leaving behind great mounds of these stones.
